subject: English
question_text: From your reading of the above passage, fill in the blanks
stimulus: with suitable words. Use one word only in each blank. 1×5=5 (a)  was 10 July 1925 (b)  Mahathir was born at his parents' home in a poor neighbourhood of Alor Setar, the capital of the state of Kedah, British Malaya on 10 July 1925. Mohamad bin Iskandar, (c)  father of Mahathir, (d)  originally from Penang. Mahathirs father (e)  was a school principal had low socioeconomic status.
guide_solution: Filling in gaps without clues (a) It; (b) when; (c) was; (d) came; (a) who.
